item.title: AI dominates SoftBank's portfolio as OpenAI gains drive profits
item.description: AI-related holdings accounted for about 18% of the SoftBank group’s net asset value roughly three years ago, but now represent more than 60%.

item.title: How a 17-year-old is using OpenAI tools to make animal healthcare smarter
item.description: Using OpenAI tools as his research collaborator, Anshul Bhatt mastered complex code and turned ambitious ideas into working prototypes. His creation, PawPath, is proof of how AI can empower a new generation of builders to create with purpose.

item.title: Honasa Consumer nearly doubles quarterly profit to Rs 50 Cr as young brands, offline expansion come in focus
item.description: Mamaearth parent Honasa Consumer’s Q3 profit soared 92% to Rs 50 crore following strong revenue. The performance was led by a recovery in Mamaearth and its other younger brands such as The Derma Co and Aqualogica, as the firm expanded its offline reach to over 2.7 lakh outlets.

item.title: “Do Not Stop”: The Timeless Wisdom of Confucius
item.description: “It does not matter how slowly you go.” Confucius’ insight on persistence and steady progress explains why consistency ultimately defines true success.

item.title: Cotton, consistency, scale: Sant Kabir Nagar's hosiery trade
item.description: In Uttar Pradesh’s Sant Kabir Nagar, cotton hosiery garments move through everyday life as quietly as they do through markets.

item.title: Industry leaders decode the future of agentic commerce at Cashfree’s Ten and Beyond event
item.description: At Cashfree Payments’ Ten and Beyond event, experts from McKinsey, Stripe, Mastercard, and Cashfree took the stage to decode how commerce in India is becoming more intuitive and less transactional in the age of agentic payments.

item.title: SmartTerra is using AI to plug India’s massive water loss problem
item.description: Up to half of urban water is lost before reaching taps. SmartTerra uses AI to analyze pipeline data, predict leaks, and reduce water loss for cities and industries across India and Southeast Asia.

item.title: ESOP reform, MSME capital, and the new architecture of startup value creation after Budget 2026
item.description: While access to capital and liquidity remains essential, the Budget also brings into sharper focus a structural friction that was previously masked by easy capital: the challenge of retaining skilled talent in long-gestation innovation businesses.
